theorem determinant (O : HaarBudget G) (hn : ∀ U,0≤R.eval U) (hn' : 1 < n.val) {g X z : ℝ}
    (hg : 0<g) (he : g≤R.p.threshold) (hm : R.beta*g^2=1)
    (F : Config G n → ℂ) (hI : Integrable F (prior G n)) (hz : 0 ≤ z)
    (H : ∀ U,z*‖F U‖ ≤ Real.exp (R.exponent U+(Fintype.card (Site n):ℝ)*X)) :
    z * ‖∫ U,F U ∂prior G n‖ / (∫ U, R.eval U∂prior G n) ≤
      Real.exp ((Fintype.card (Site n):ℝ)*protection O R A Λ δ X g-
        4 * G.lieDim * Real.log g) := by

proof_context.conclusion: `determinant` bounds `z*‖∫F‖/∫eval` by `exp(card Site * protection - 4 lieDim log g)` for `F` with `z‖F‖ ≤ exp(exponent + card Site * X)`.

lemma denture (hn :∀ U,0 ≤ P.eval U) (hL : 1 < n.val) (hg : 0<g) (hp : g ≤ P.p.threshold) (hβ:P.beta*g^2=1)
    (F : Config G n→ℂ) (hI : Integrable F (prior G n)) (hz : 0≤z) (hQ : ∀ U,z*‖F U‖≤ Real.exp (P.exponent U+(K:ℝ)*X)) :
    z* ‖∫ U,F U ∂prior G n‖ / (∫ U,P.eval U∂prior G n) ≤ Real.exp ((K:ℝ)*protection O P s Λ δ X g-4*G.lieDim*Real.log g):= by

proof_context.conclusion: `denture` is the same ratio estimate with `K` cells and the exponent discrepancy absorbed.
